config.recovery_R: same pending set at snapshot; no healthy reexecution
config.feedback_checkpoint: after both extraction nodes; before timeline/relations/verify/report
config.if_no_natural_anomaly: record runtime-feedback exploration; no anomaly-specific benefit claim
stop_before_any_paid_request: matching lock-bound batch authorization/account confirmation missing
request payload or reservation exceeds cap
config.future_confirmation: four-event design retained separately; no automatic launch

policy.objective: unchanged latency-first, then native CNY, then native USD, then lexical model names; no new Q utility
policy.initial: same frozen choose() on full DAG with scale={} and calibration-only profile; freeze before evaluation requests
policy.static: retain initial pending pi; feasibility uses same observed feedback as dynamic
policy.dynamic: same choose() enumerates pending pi including retention; same R and Z
policy.profile_mapping: by exact output_contract, calibration task to evaluation; source-document extraction variants share one observed contract sample per model; record transfer uncertainty
policy.missing: unmeasured resource profile remains UNKNOWN; refuse unsupported plan, do not impute. Model Q/E/K failure retained; not all-model-success gate
policy.feedback: at extraction barrier, for each observed model take max(actual extraction wall/calibration extraction wall); unobserved model scale=1 with NO_NEW_OBSERVATION label. This model-wide latency transfer is a hypothesis, not measured downstream latency. Both arms use identical scale. No fabricated timeout or source failure.
policy.quality: Q/E/K observed separately, UNKNOWN retained; frozen choose has no calibrated Q or reliability constraint guarantee
policy.selection_on_evaluation: no changing initial policy with later pairs; each pair uses same initial pi, fresh prefix and own feedback; no online learning between pairs

config.scoring: tiered exploratory reference and output review; PENDING excluded, UNKNOWN unfilled, per-tier coverage and denominators reported, no full Q from partial scores
